description: This GOV.UK collection gathers the official documents of Great Britain's Capacity Market, which ensures security of electricity supply by paying reliable sources of capacity. It was published on 24 July 2014 and last updated on 23 January 2023, and its update log lists items such as an open letter to National Grid ESO on the 2023 auction parameters, the government response to the Capacity Market technical amendments consultation, a state aid process statement, the response to the Tempus Energy state aid challenge, a stakeholder workshop summary and the locations of provisional auction results from 2014. Access: free to read without registration; documents are HTML and PDF, and GOV.UK content is generally published under the Open Government Licence, though the page text read here does not say so. Coverage is the GB Capacity Market rules and auctions. Caveats: this is a document collection, not a numeric data set, the latest update dates from early 2023, and later scheme documents may sit elsewhere. It suits capacity planning and resilience policy studies of adequacy mechanisms, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
